main_subject.detail: A premium lipstick-offer poster with a Holiday 2022 YSL lipstick standing beside its decorative gold box on the left, and two small skincare gift items on the right. The top text reads 'SON MÔI RPC HOLIDAY 2022 OS'. Round badges say 'MUA 1.140K' and 'TẶNG 466K'. Lower copy says 'KEM LÓT NÂNG TÔNG TOP SECRETS INSTANT TONE UP ROSYLIGHT' and 'HYDRA BOUNCE LOTION 10ML'.
